name: Buru the Gorger
notes: Numbers follow docs/research/ruins-of-ahnqiraj/buru.md (no Era HP: SoM 1,066,000 only). ESTIMATES: the Hatchery is a 46 yd round room around a pool; six eggs on a 30 yd ring counter-clockwise from the South egg stand in for the real ring (count not stated on any source), and six egg pops take him from 100% to 20% (real 10-12 pops, 8-12 minutes; here 8 s for the first egg, then 41.5 s per egg). UNVERIFIED: the real room layout (pool depth and distances; no map or coordinates). Gathering Speed is modelled (Wowhead 1834: +25% run speed, stacks; both emulators: +25% every 9 s, reset on an egg hit): `gatheringSpeed` adds +25% at 2 s and then every 9 s since the last egg, capped at x4, from a base 2.2 yd/s. The egg's `eggBurst` has a hidden follow-up `eggReset` that sets it back to base when the egg actually bursts (the engine applies a hazard's `bossSpeedMult` when the hazard is placed, 2.5 s before it goes off, so the reset cannot sit on the hazard itself). So he is slower than a 7 yd/s player at the start of a cycle and about 6.7 yd/s by its end, and a stationary kiter gets caught. The kite itself is a 41.5 s lap, one full lap of the pool plus one egg per cycle: five 8.3 s legs (`wpN_1..4` then `kiteN`, 84 degrees apart at radius 41, chords that clear the pool), computed so a kiter who keeps moving stays outside his melee reach all the way round, and he crosses the egg as it bursts. The real gap between eggs is 30-60 s while the egg group prepares the next one; the lap is the sim's stand-in for that wait. At the transform he gets Full Speed (+300%): `bossSpeedMult: 4` on `transform`, 8.8 yd/s, permanent. Boss melee is scaled so a 10,000 HP kiter who is caught takes real damage and a player healer who ignores the kiter loses them (`healPerSecondWithPlayerHealer` 30, `lowHp` 0.7 because a kiter who is low has no second chance). P1 structure: the `tank` role is the kiter (the fixated raider in the real fight): Buru chases you, you lead him onto each egg, the egg bursts (`hazard` at the egg's spot) and a Hatchling spawns. The real tank's P1 job is the off-tank role here (Hatchlings); in the sim's P2 the `tank` role picks him up, in the real fight a warrior would. Fixation is the `fixate` `targetSwitch` after each pop: Buru is immune to Taunt in the real fight; the sim's Taunt press stands for 'you are the new fixate, start moving'. For non-tank roles a `carried` zone (`fixateYou`) lands on a random raider who must run out of the group toward the next egg, standing in for being the fixate target, and the ghost kiter closes on him to re-take the fixate, which is the kiter's main exposure. Dismember (Wowhead 96: 5 yd melee, 1,248 every 2 s for 10 s, stacking) is a `debuff` gated by `conditional: tankInMelee` on its real 5 s cadence: it lands only while he is in melee of the kiter, 12.5 yd centre to centre for his 4.5 yd hitbox and 7 yd melee range, at 624 per stack per second (the real 1,248 per 2 s), so being caught twice is lethal. `dismemberBite` is the 800 weapon hit that lands with it at the same reach and scores the catch (`caughtByBuru`). Kite spots are 16 yd from each egg, outside that reach with him on the egg. Thorns (200 to attackers in P1) cannot be modelled with `shield`, because a shield also blocks attacks on eggs and hatchlings, so 'do not hit him in P1' is scored as `attacksOffPriority` while an egg is alive; between eggs nothing punishes it. The egg group and healers stand on the shore at radius 19 (research: the kiter must not swim in deep water and priests Levitate over it to keep line of sight; pool depth unmeasured), 11 yd from the egg and outside its 10 yd ring; healer spots move with the kiter's leg so they stay within 40 yd (about 22 yd). Eggs are stationary (`speed: 0`) `killFirst` adds, one per cycle with a lifetime matching the cycle: the DPS job in P1, standing in for the real egg group bringing it to 5% and popping it when Buru is on top. `attack.addDamage` is 0 here, so attacks are scored but only the burst pops the egg; pop timing (do not pop early, no DoTs) cannot be modelled and is not scored. The egg's damage to Buru (45,000 per wiki/Millenium, 40,000 TenTonHammer, 7% Wowhead/AzerothCore, 15% CMaNGOS) has no effect on the phase-clock HP. Eggs do not respawn here (TenTonHammer says they do; wiki silent). Hatchlings are killable adds for the off-tank role (one per egg, real), spawning at the start of the following cycle because an expectation cannot straddle a phase change; in the burn phase `hatch6` keeps spawning to stand in for the remaining eggs hatching (CMaNGOS). Egg burst damage to players (100-500 by distance, 25 yd) is a flat 400 in a 10 yd ring on the egg. P2 (transform at 20%) is a `threatWipe` with `creepingPlague` as a `maxStacks` debuff (65 per second per stack, every 6 s), 30 s to kill (research 25-30 s); the real 80-per-tick ramp and 'every third tick' stepping are not modelled.

labels.text: South egg: start the loop here

tank.label: Main tank
tank.description:
Buru is fixated on you. Start at the South egg and run counter-clockwise around the pool, leading him over each egg. He gains 25% speed every 9 seconds after an egg breaks, so keep moving.

Stay out of melee range: Dismember stacks and deals 1,248 damage every 2 seconds. Use Taunt when his eye returns to you after an egg. Here, that button means you've become the new fixate target; the real boss is immune to Taunt. In the last phase, you also take over the warrior's job of picking him up after the transformation.

offtank.label: Hatchling off-tank
offtank.description: Your job is the hatchlings: pick each one up as it spawns from an egg and hold it off the raid while the DPS kill it.

melee.label: Melee DPS
melee.description: Kill the current egg, not Buru (99% reduced damage in the shell). Step back from its burst, and run out of the group if he fixes on you.

ranged.label: Ranged DPS
ranged.description: Kill the current egg, stay on your egg-group spot and step out of the burst. If Buru fixes on you, run out of the group toward the next egg.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: The kiter takes Dismember first: heal them through it. When he transforms, Creeping Plague ramps on everyone and you have about 25 seconds: stack up and heal the group.

taunt.label: Taunt
taunt.tip: Stands for: you are the new fixate. In the sim it brings him back onto you.

attack.label: Attack
attack.tip: Attacks generate threat. Stop when the threat bar turns red so the boss stays on the tank.

heal.label: Heal the tank
heal.tip: A large heal for the tank. Time it to land with the incoming damage.

dismember.label: Dismember
dismember.tip: A stacking bleed if he reaches you in melee: 1,248 every 2 seconds for 10 seconds, stacking. Be caught twice and you are dead.

dismemberBite.label: Caught by Buru
dismemberBite.tip: He reached you: the weapon hit that lands with Dismember.

fixate.label: Buru fixates
fixate.toast: Buru sets his eyes on someone else. Run!
fixate.tip: Each egg that hits him makes him choose a new random target. If it is you, run to the next egg.

fixateYou.label: Fixated on you
fixateYou.tip: Buru is after you. Run out of the group toward the next egg and do not stop.

eggReset.label: Gathering Speed resets
eggReset.tip: The egg burst resets his Gathering Speed.

transform.label: Buru transforms
transform.toast: Buru transforms: shell off, threat gone, Creeping Plague begins
transform.tip: At 20% the shell breaks. Threat is wiped, Creeping Plague ramps on the whole raid, and you have about 25 to 30 seconds. Tank: take him. Everyone else: burn.

creepingPlague.label: Creeping Plague
creepingPlague.tip: A ramping raid-wide Nature debuff. It cannot be dispelled.

gatheringSpeed.label: Gathering Speed
gatheringSpeed.tip: +25% run speed every 9 s since the last egg.

eggAdd1.label: Buru Egg
eggAdd1.tip: The next egg. Kill it, and when the kiter has Buru on top of it, the shell cracks.

hatch1.label: Hive'Zara Hatchling
hatch1.tip: A Hatchling pops out of the egg. Off-tank: grab it. DPS: kill it.

eggBurst1.label: Egg burst
eggBurst1.tip: A ring on the egg: about 400 up close, falling off with distance. When it bursts it resets his speed.

threatLostCount.label: Times the boss turned on the raid

aggroPulls.label: Times you pulled aggro
aggroPulls.tip: Stop attacking when the threat bar turns red.

attacksInRed.label: Attacks in the red band
attacksInRed.tip: Stop attacking in the red band so the tank can regain a threat lead.

earlyAttacks.label: Attacks before the tank had the boss
earlyAttacks.tip: Give the tank a few seconds after the pull.

dpsIdle.label: Seconds not attacking when you could
dpsIdle.tip: Keep attacking when it's safe. Stop if the threat bar turns red or the boss leaves the tank.

playerInHazard.label: Seconds standing in something bad
playerInHazard.tip: Move out of the ground effect before attacking again.

tankLowSeconds.label: Seconds with the tank under half
tankLowSeconds.tip: Top the tank up before the spike lands, not after.

overheals.label: Wasted heals
overheals.tip: Avoid healing the tank at full health. Save the heal for incoming damage.

attacksOffPriority.label: Boss attacks while a priority add was alive
attacksOffPriority.tip: Face the add and kill it first. The boss can wait.

whelpsOnRaid.label: Adds loose on the raid
whelpsOnRaid.tip: Grab the adds before they reach a raid member and keep them on you.

caughtByBuru.label: Times he caught you
caughtByBuru.tip: Stay ahead of him. Every catch is Dismember.

draggedThroughRaid.label: Times you took Buru through the raid
draggedThroughRaid.tip: If he fixes on you, run away from the group.

cues.notes: Taunt back after the fixate; pick up Hatchlings; heal the kiter when low.

list.label: Taunt when Buru turns on the raid
list.tip: Taunt as soon as the boss turns toward the raid.

drills.name: Egg kite
drills.description: Kite Buru around the pool and over the egg. Keep moving: he speeds up 25% every 9 s. Taunt only when he comes back to you.

drills.name: Egg first
drills.description: Kill the egg, not Buru, step back from the burst and carry a fixate away from the group.

drills.name: Hatchling pickup
drills.description: A Hatchling every 12 s. Pick it up and hold it.

drills.name: Heal through the transform
drills.description: Creeping Plague stacks every 3 seconds. Keep healing the kiter through Plague and Dismember.

limitations: Egg damage does not control the fight. Egg explosions, armour loss and fixates are scripted rather than caused by your actions.
